PROCEDURE ADD_REQ_ATTR (pUnit_id in varchar2, 
 pProd in varchar2, 
 pChapter in varchar2, 
 pAttrib in varchar2,
 pAction in varchar2)
IS
BEGIN
 --message(pUnit_id || ' ' || pProd || ' ' || pChapter || ' ' || pAttrib || ' ' || pAction);
 IF pAction = 'ADD' THEN
 INSERT into BC_SPATR--@lab
 (UNIT_ID, PRODTYPE, CHAPTER_ID, ATTRIB_CODE, INSERT_DATS, INSERT_USER,
 AUDIT_KEY, PROGRAM_ID)
 values
 (pUNIT_ID, pProd, pChapter, pAttrib, sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 NULL, :banner.prog_name);
 ELSIF pAction = 'REMOVE' THEN
 DELETE FROM BC_SPATR--@lab
 WHERE unit_id = pUnit_id
 AND prodtype = pProd
 AND chapter_id = pChapter
 AND attrib_code = pAttrib;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 --WHEN others THEN
 -- message(sqlerrm); 
 WHEN dup_val_on_index THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 raise;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FETCH_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FETCH_DETAILS IS
 No_Prod_Defined Boolean := TRUE;
 ctr Number := 0;
 Cursor C1 is
 SELECT dd.last_name || ', ' || dd.first_name name, dd.prod_type1, 
 dd.prod_type2, dd.prod_type3, 
 su.unit_id,su.coll_date, dd.seq_no, 
 dd.chapter_id
 FROM dirdes_donors dd, special_units su 
 WHERE dd.pat_id = :transf_details.pat_id
 AND dd.surg_id = :transf_details.surg_id
 AND dd.chapter_id = :transf_details.chapter_id
 AND dd.chapter_id = :Global.Chapter_Id
 AND dd.pat_id = su.pat_id (+)
 AND dd.surg_id = su.surg_id (+)
 AND dd.seq_no = su.seq_no (+)
 AND dd.chapter_id = su.chapter_id (+)
 ORDER BY DD.SEQ_NO DESC;
BEGIN
 set_item_property('TRANSF_DETAILS.pat_id',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('TRANSF_DETAILS.pat_id',navigable,property_true);
 set_item_property('TRANSF_DETAILS.comments',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('TRANSF_DETAILS.comments',navigable,property_true);
 go_block('TRANSF_DETAILS');
 execute_query(no_validate);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_print1',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_print1',navigable,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_print2',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_print2',navigable,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_print3',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_print3',navigable,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_copies1',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_copies2',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.s_copies3',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.S_DON_TYPE',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.S_DON_TYPE',navigable,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.S_DON_TYPE',insert_allowed,property_true);
 --set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.S_IRR',enabled,property_true);
 --set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.S_IRR',navigable,property_true);
 --set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.S_IRR',insert_allowed,property_true);
 FOR attrcnt in 1 .. 8 loop
 IF get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR' || to_char(attrcnt), DISPLAYED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR' || to_char(attrcnt), enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR' || to_char(attrcnt), navigable, property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR' || to_char(attrcnt), insert_allowed, property_true);
 END IF;
 END LOOP; 

 go_block('CTRL_DONATIONS');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 first_record;
 open c1;
 loop
 fetch c1 into :ctrl_donations.s_donor_name,
 :ctrl_donations.s_prod1,
 :ctrl_donations.s_prod2,
 :ctrl_donations.s_prod3,
 :ctrl_donations.s_unit_id,
 :ctrl_donations.s_coll_date,
 :ctrl_donations.seq_no,
 :ctrl_donations.chapter_id;
 IF No_Prod_Defined THEN
 IF :ctrl_donations.s_prod1 is not null
 or :ctrl_donations.s_prod2 is not null 
 or :ctrl_donations.s_prod3 is not null
 THEN
 No_Prod_Defined := FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --:ctrl_donations.s_don_type := :transf_details.s_pat_type;
 exit when c1%notfound;
 ctr := ctr + 1;
 if :ctrl_donations.s_unit_id is not null then
 IF length(:ctrl_donations.s_unit_id) = 13 THEN
 :ctrl_donations.s_chk_digit := isbt_chk_digit(:ctrl_donations.s_unit_id);
 END IF; 
 begin
 select donor_id, coll_date 
 into :ctrl_donations.s_donor_id, :ctrl_donations.s_coll_date
 from donations
 where unit_id = :ctrl_donations.s_unit_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 select last_name || decode(last_name,null,null,', ') || first_name
 into :ctrl_donations.s_donor_name
 from donors 
 where donor_id = :ctrl_donations.s_donor_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception 
 when others then
 null;
 end;
 end if;
 set_ctrl_donations_prop;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 if :ctrl_donations.s_donor_name is null then
 delete_record;
 end if;
 close c1;
 go_record(1);
 set_item_property('TRANSF_DETAILS.pat_id',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('TRANSF_DETAILS.Comments',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.s_patient_id',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.find_pat',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.opt',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.pb_retrieve',enabled,property_false);
 /*synchronize;*/
 IF ctr = 0 THEN
 show_error('99007');
 END IF;
 IF No_Prod_Defined THEN
 show_error('99005');
 END IF;
 IF Link_Error THEN
 show_error('99008');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_MATCHING_PATIENTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Get_matching_patients IS
 cursor C_Exact is
 SELECT SP.PAT_ID, SP.PAT_LAST_NAME, SP.PAT_FIRST_NAME, SP.DOB,
 TD.SURG_ID, TD.SURG_DATE, TD.CHAPTER_ID
 FROM SPECIAL_PATIENTS SP, TRANSF_DETAILS TD 
 WHERE (SP.PAT_LAST_NAME = :Ctrl_Blk_1.Find_Pat
 OR SP.PAT_FIRST_NAME = :Ctrl_blk_1.Find_Pat)
 AND SP.CHAPTER_ID = :Global.chapter_id
 AND SP.PAT_ID = TD.PAT_ID
 AND SP.CHAPTER_ID = TD.CHAPTER_ID
 ORDER BY TD.SURG_DATE DESC;
 cursor C_Like is 
 SELECT SP.PAT_ID, SP.PAT_LAST_NAME, SP.PAT_FIRST_NAME, SP.DOB,
 TD.SURG_ID, TD.SURG_DATE, TD.CHAPTER_ID
 FROM SPECIAL_PATIENTS SP, TRANSF_DETAILS TD 
 WHERE (SP.PAT_LAST_NAME like '%'||:Ctrl_Blk_1.Find_Pat||'%'
 OR SP.PAT_FIRST_NAME like '%'||:Ctrl_blk_1.Find_Pat||'%')
 AND SP.CHAPTER_ID = :Global.chapter_id
 AND SP.PAT_ID = TD.PAT_ID
 AND SP.CHAPTER_ID = TD.CHAPTER_ID
 ORDER BY TD.SURG_DATE DESC;
 cursor C_Sound is 
 SELECT SP.PAT_ID, SP.PAT_LAST_NAME, SP.PAT_FIRST_NAME, SP.DOB,
 TD.SURG_ID, TD.SURG_DATE, TD.CHAPTER_ID
 FROM SPECIAL_PATIENTS SP, TRANSF_DETAILS TD 
 WHERE (soundex(SP.PAT_LAST_NAME) = soundex(:Ctrl_Blk_1.Find_Pat)
 OR soundex(SP.PAT_FIRST_NAME) = soundex(:Ctrl_blk_1.Find_Pat))
 AND SP.CHAPTER_ID = :Global.chapter_id
 AND SP.PAT_ID = TD.PAT_ID
 AND SP.CHAPTER_ID = TD.CHAPTER_ID
 ORDER BY TD.SURG_DATE DESC;
 c_rec c_exact%rowtype;
BEGIN
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = 'LIKE' THEN
 Open C_Like;
 ELSIF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = '=' THEN
 Open C_Exact;
 ELSIF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = 'SOUNDEX' THEN
 Open C_sound;
 END IF;
 GO_BLOCK('CTRL_PATIENTS');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 Loop
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = 'LIKE' THEN
 Fetch C_Like INTO c_rec;
 exit when c_Like%notfound;
 ELSIF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = '=' THEN
 Fetch C_Exact INTO c_rec;
 exit when c_exact%notfound;
 ELSIF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = 'SOUNDEX' THEN
 Fetch C_sound INTO c_rec;
 exit when c_sound%notfound;
 END IF;
 :Ctrl_Patients.Pat_Id := c_rec.pat_id;
 :Ctrl_Patients.Pat_last_name := c_rec.pat_last_name;
 :Ctrl_Patients.Pat_first_name := c_rec.pat_first_name;
 :Ctrl_Patients.DOB := c_rec.DOB;
 :Ctrl_Patients.Surg_Id := c_rec.surg_id;
 :Ctrl_Patients.Surg_date := c_rec.surg_date;
 :Ctrl_Patients.Chapter_ID := c_rec.chapter_id;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = 'LIKE' THEN
 Close C_Like;
 ELSIF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = '=' THEN
 Close C_Exact;
 ELSIF :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT = 'SOUNDEX' THEN
 Close C_sound;
 END IF;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 IF :Ctrl_Patients.PAT_ID is null THEN
 go_block('CTRL_BLK_1');
 hide_view('SEARCH_PATIENT');
 show_error('14301');
 END IF;
END;

 For i in 1 ..8 loop

 get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i),prompt_text) = :ctrl_blk_1.ir_prompt
 THEN
 :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_IRR := name_in('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i));
 vattrib_col := 'CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i);
 exit;
 END IF;
 End Loop;
 ---Add Mandatory Irradiation Check here 4.01.03
 --:ctrl_donations.s_irr := null;
 declare
 vTemp varchar2(1);
 begin

ProgramUnit.Name: ISBT_CHK_DIGIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION ISBT_CHK_DIGIT(pUnit in varchar2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 vRetval varchar2(1);
 iter number := length(pUnit);
 vChar varchar2(1);
 vCalcNum number := 0;
 vNum number := 0;
begin
 for x in 1 .. iter loop
 vChar := substr(pUnit,x,1);
 vNum := 0;
 --For numerics
 If ltrim(vChar,'0123456789') is not null then
 vNum := ascii(vChar)-55;
 else
 vNum := ascii(vChar)-48;
 end if;
 vCalcNum := mod((vCalcNum+vNum)*2,37);
 end loop;
 vCalcNum := mod(38-vCalcNum,37);
 vCalcNum := vCalcNum + 1;
 vRetval := substr('0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ*',vCalcNum,1);
 return vRetval;
exception
 when others then
 return null;
END;

FUNCTION Link_Error RETURN boolean IS
 vPatID varchar2(10) := :TRANSF_DETAILS.PAT_ID;
 vSurgID varchar2(10) := :TRANSF_DETAILS.SURG_ID;
 vRetvar boolean := False;
 cursor c1 is
 select seq_no, count(1) cnt
 from special_units
 where pat_id = vPatID
 and surg_id = vSurgID
 and chapter_id = :Global.chapter_ID
 group by seq_no;
BEGIN
 for rec in c1 loop
 IF rec.cnt > 1 Then
 vRetvar := True;
 exit;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 return vRetvar;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_PROC IS
 cur_rec number(3) := :system.cursor_record;
 procedure ADD_REM_ATTR(prd_type in varchar2) IS
 begin
 for i in 1..8 loop
 IF :ctrl_donations.s_unit_id is not null THEN
 IF get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i),DISPLAYED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i),prompt_text) = :ctrl_blk_1.ir_prompt
 and nvl(:ctrl_donations.s_irr,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 ADD_REQ_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_unit_id, 
 prd_type, 
 :ctrl_donations.chapter_id,
 get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i),PROMPT_TEXT),
 'ADD'); 
 ELSIF get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i),prompt_text) = :ctrl_blk_1.ir_prompt
 and nvl(:ctrl_donations.s_irr,'N') = 'N' THEN
 ADD_REQ_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_unit_id, 
 prd_type, 
 :ctrl_donations.chapter_id,
 get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i),PROMPT_TEXT),
 'REMOVE'); 
 ELSE 
 IF name_in('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i)) = 'Y' THEN
 ADD_REQ_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_unit_id, 
 prd_type, 
 :ctrl_donations.chapter_id,
 get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i),PROMPT_TEXT),
 'ADD');
 ELSIF name_in('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i)) = 'N' THEN 
 ADD_REQ_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_unit_id, 
 prd_type, 
 :ctrl_donations.chapter_id,
 get_item_property('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR'||to_char(i),PROMPT_TEXT),
 'REMOVE');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 end loop;
 end; 
BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.cur_printer is null THEN
 GET_PRINTER;
 END IF;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.cur_printer is null THEN
 show_error('99001');
 return;
 END IF;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 IF (:CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT1 = 'Y'
 OR :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT2 = 'Y'
 OR :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT3 = 'Y')
 THEN 
 FOR i in 1 .. 8 loop
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR' || to_char(i),displayed) = 'TRUE'
 and NAME_IN('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR' || to_char(i)) is null 
 THEN 
 go_item('CTRL_DONATIONS.ATTR' || to_char(i));
 show_error('0080'); 
 END IF;
 END LOOP; 
 END IF;
 IF (:CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT1 = 'Y'
 OR :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT2 = 'Y'
 OR :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT3 = 'Y')
 AND nvl(:CTRL_DONATIONS.S_DON_TYPE,'X') = 'X' then
 go_item('ctrl_donations.s_don_type');
 show_error('99006');
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 IF :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT1 = 'Y' THEN
 IRRADIATED_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_prod1);
 submit_report(:ctrl_donations.s_copies1, :ctrl_donations.s_prod1);
 ADD_REM_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_prod1);
 END IF;
 IF :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT2 = 'Y' THEN
 IRRADIATED_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_prod2);
 submit_report(:ctrl_donations.s_copies2, :ctrl_donations.s_prod2);
 ADD_REM_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_prod2);
 END IF;
 IF :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_PRINT3 = 'Y' THEN
 IRRADIATED_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_prod3);
 submit_report(:ctrl_donations.s_copies3, :ctrl_donations.s_prod3);
 ADD_REM_ATTR(:ctrl_donations.s_prod3);
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 :system.message_level := 20;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 5;

 go_record(cur_rec);
END;

PROCEDURE SUBMIT_REPORT(p_copies in number, p_prd in varchar2) IS

 v_desname varchar2(50);

 vTempSeq number;
 vSurgDateSeq number;
 vHLA varchar2(1);
 vSurgDt date;
 vNeedDt DATE;
BEGIN
 
 SELECT substr(description,1,20), nvl(sort_sequence_3,0), 
 nvl(sort_sequence_2,0)
 INTO vP_Type, vTempSeq, vSurgDateSeq
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'PATTY'
 AND code = :ctrl_donations.s_don_type;
 IF vTempSeq > 100 THEN
 vHLA := 'Y';
 ELSE
 vHLA := 'N';
 END IF;
 IF vSurgDateSeq > 100 THEN
 vSurgDt := null;
 ELSE
 vSurgDt := :TRANSF_DETAILS.SURG_DATE;
 END IF;

 vNeedDt := :TRANSF_DETAILS.DATE_NEEDED_BY;

 BEGIN 
 LT_TIETAG_LABEL.GEN_ADTT_FILE (:TRANSF_DETAILS.PAT_ID,
 :CTRL_DONATIONS.SEQ_NO,
 :TRANSF_DETAILS.SURG_ID,
 vNeedDt, -- vSurgDt, -- IM 536 (use need dt as label has need by field)
 vP_Type,
 p_prd,
 :CTRL_DONATIONS.S_IRR,
 vHLA,
 p_copies,
 :ctrl_blk_1.cur_printer); 
 END;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END;
